acceptance_evidence: CCA verdict and MergeGate evidence are recorded before completion.
completion_conditions: A high/critical task's bookkeeping closeout passes the MergeGate policy check with no Guardian approval.
Every ADR 0017 disqualifier still blocks on the policy path.
post_merge_reconcile PRs behave exactly as before.
The full suite, the governance-evidence suite, the workflow-lint script and validate_shiki stay green.

decisions: The policy job in `.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml` passes `--base-shiki` but computes `MERGED_PRS` inside `if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q '<!-- shiki:post_merge_reconcile -->'`. A bookkeeping closeout carries no such marker, so `MERGED_PRS` is empty, ADR 0017 condition 6 (the implementation PR is merged) cannot be established, and the classifier fails closed — correctly, on an input the job simply never supplied.

The fix is to resolve the merged-PR proof unconditionally, exactly as the CCA job's Prepare CCA context step already does: read the BASE task's `expected_pr` (a field the PR head cannot write) and include it only when `gh pr view` reports it MERGED. The post_merge_reconcile path keeps consuming the same value, so its behaviour must not change.

The wiring points were enumerated mechanically this time rather than guessed, because the count has been wrong four times in this ADR's rollout. Decision sites in code: `mergegate_check.py` `_builtin_guardian_risk_required` and `risk_requires_guardian` (both read `_guardian_risk_labels`, already exempt-aware), and `guardian_approval_signal.py` (already wired). Invocation sites that must supply classifier inputs: `shiki-cca-completion.yml` line 67 (the signal, wired), line 518 (the policy job — THIS task), and `shiki-mergegate.yml` line 71 (the metadata job).

The metadata job is deliberately out of scope and is not a gap: it passes no `--pr-json`, so it does not evaluate the Guardian gate for a normal PR at all. Verified empirically on PRs #212 and #213, where the metadata check passed while the policy check blocked on Guardian. Its file is also held by another task's lock.
grill_with_docs.source: Live on closeout PRs #212 and #213, 2026-07-31: the CCA guardian signal reported required=false with bookkeeping_closeout_exemption=true, while `MergeGate policy check` blocked on 'Guardian label guardian:approved is missing'.

non_goals: Changing the six ADR 0017 conditions or the classifier.
Changing post_merge_reconcile's merge-proof semantics or the mode's validation.
Resolving the implementation PR from the HEAD task's expected_pr — it must come from the BASE snapshot, which the PR cannot write.
Modifying .github/workflows/shiki-mergegate.yml or scripts/mergegate_check.py (held by other tasks / out of scope).
Making the policy check more permissive than the CCA signal, or vice versa.
outcome: The ADR 0017 exemption reaches the last gate. The CCA signal already exempts a proven bookkeeping closeout; the MergeGate policy check still requires Guardian approval because its merged-PR proof is only computed for `post_merge_reconcile` PRs, which a closeout is not. After this, a high/critical task's closeout merges with zero Guardian approvals.
title: Give the MergeGate policy job the merged-PR proof a closeout needs
